notes: Defect: promo code discount amount is missing or incorrect in the Mozio email confirmation specifically for return trip tickets. The map-to-sanitized-mozio-dispatch mapper passes discount.amount through from the dispatch report, so the root cause likely lies upstream in how the discount is computed or applied for return-trip dispatches (apply-report-discounts.service.ts or map-line-item-return-trip-modification.ts). The sanitized mapper itself appears to pass the value correctly when present, suggesting the discount data is either not populated or incorrectly calculated for return trips before reaching the mapper.

notes: Openspec provided empty acceptance criteria, so all criteria are new. I built criteria around the core defect (return-trip discount missing/incorrect) and added: AC-2 as a one-way regression guard; AC-3 and AC-4 for edge cases (no discount, zero discount); AC-5 and AC-7 to ensure the discount value survives the upstream pipeline stages mentioned in the technical notes (apply-report-discounts, map-line-item-return-trip-modification, create-reservations); AC-6 to cover the webhook path; AC-8 for fractional-amount rounding consistency. All criteria are expressed as observable outcomes without referencing implementation details.
